column1: # Rows db.xml.ps.* (line RG-F3, agent D6 of ad-RG-F3-5, 2026-11-23): psiblast -in_pssm of an XML PSSM, which NCBI reads with its XML object stream (with the manipulator MSerial_Xml, blast_args.cpp:1338-1360) and reports any CSerialException of as `Unrecognized format for PSSM in <file> (must be PssmWithParameters)`. (1) The XML twins tests/fixtures/pssm/ps9_<name>.xml(.gz, gzip -9 -n, when over 20 KB) of the text PSSMs of the BER twins (db.ps.inpssm.bin.*), written by datatool 2.24.0 of the bioconda BLAST 2.17.0 package (datatool -m all_pssm.asn -v x.asn -px x.xml; the round trip back to text is datatool's own print; where datatool's text reader wrote '#' for a byte outside the visible range the source's bytes are put back; ps9_two.xml is the two objects' documents one after the other): each row is the text row of the same name without .xml (db.xml.ps.tk.0 = db.ps.inpssm.tk.0) with the twin as its query. (2) Hand-made inputs ps9_xml_<case>.xml(.gz) of remaining-gaps-20261112/F/f3/tmp/d6/gen_xml_defects.py, one change each on the XML twin of the rnd PSSM (pssm-gz:, the cases NCBI reads) or of the one-column PSSM ps7_one (pssm:, the cases NCBI refuses, whose message names the file): the declaration, DOCTYPE, comments and processing instructions, attributes, tags, numbers (a bad or overflowing INTEGER is NCBI's CUtilException, exit 255), BOOLEAN and ENUMERATED values and their missing values (`eMissingValue`: an OPTIONAL or DEFAULT member unset, a mandatory one an error), REAL, character data (control bytes: 803.7 with the line, entities, character references, CDATA), OCTET STRING hex, an empty CHOICE element (FindEmpty), namespace prefixes and declarations, `nil` attributes (NStr::StringToBool's CStringException for a value that is no boolean, exit 255), the standard form (datatool -sxo); (-comp_based_stats 0 -evalue 1000, outfmt 7, against tests/db_search/paja). (3) db.xml.ps.dl_* and their .outpssm runs (-num_iterations 1 -out_pssm, files pssm-asn): the delayed member Auth-list.names of a pub descriptor (the XML twin of d3b_dl_base.asn.gz with one change): NCBI's read skips it by its type (its tags, entities and missing values checked, its strings and numbers not), and the ASN.1 text of -out_pssm reads it first (CDelayBuffer::Update): a replaced byte's 803.7 under the read's own trace and line, an Int4 overflow NCBI's exception from its writer after the bytes written (LOSAT refuses: dl_ovf.outpssm). Freeze them alone with `freeze --program psiblast --only db.xml.ps.`.
